zh.title: 公開頁 vs 登入
zh.question: 公開頁和登入客戶端，該共用一套，還是拆開？看起來像，權限能不能也像。

analyst.answer: 公開頁給看。登入客戶端給用。不要共用一條權限。
analyst.review: 看起來像，不是權限像。讀者和操作者要分開寫。

researcher.answer: 會被索引的頁，不該出現只該在會話裡的內容。
researcher.review: 索引只是一條外洩面。錯誤頁和快取是另外兩條。

engineer.answer: 公開回放是靜態頁。登入操作走伺服器。
engineer.review: 外觀可以共用組件。私有路徑不能進公開包。

critic.answer: 用旗標把私有路徑藏在公開包裡，旗標忘了就洩。
critic.review: 分開路由不夠。公開包裡不能有那條路徑的程式。

strategist.answer: 外觀可以像。權限和資料必須分開。
strategist.review: 像，要寫成看起來像。不要寫成就是同一套。

writer.answer: 公開頁寫明這是回放。登入頁寫明這會動真資料。
writer.review: 這兩句不能合成一句「我們很安全」。

quant.answer: 公開頁不該產生 Key 帳單。帳單只在登入路徑。
quant.review: 零 Key 是公開頁的驗收，不是文案。

chair.answer: 公開頁只做回放，不持鑰。登入客戶端另走伺服器。外觀可以像，權限不能共用。

en.title: Public page vs login
en.question: Should the public page and the signed-in client share one app, or only look alike?

analyst.answer: The public page is for watching. The client is for using. Don't share a permission.
analyst.review: Looking alike is not the same permission. Name the reader and the operator apart.

researcher.answer: A page that can be indexed must not hold session-only content.
researcher.review: Indexing is one leak. Error pages and caches are two more.

engineer.answer: Public replay is a static page. Signed-in actions go through the server.
engineer.review: Shared components are fine. A private path must not ship in the public bundle.

critic.answer: A private path behind a flag in the public bundle leaks when the flag is forgotten.
critic.review: Split routes are not enough. The public bundle must not contain that code.

strategist.answer: The look can match. Permission and data must not.
strategist.review: Write that it looks alike. Don't write that it is the same app.

writer.answer: The public page says this is a replay. The signed-in page says this touches real data.
writer.review: Those two lines must not collapse into we are safe.

quant.answer: The public page should not create a key bill. The bill stays on the signed-in path.
quant.review: Zero keys is an acceptance test for the public page, not copy.

chair.answer: The public page only replays and holds no key. Login uses the server. Looks may match. Permission may not.
